label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_04
text: Each time I recall our artistic battle, I’ve found\nmyself wishing to face you once again...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_05
text: I am so very glad that you are here! Praise\nMother Nature![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_06
text: I had planned to meet with the Top Champion\ntoday, but I have just now canceled that plan!\r\nShall we instead talk of art together?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_07
text: What? You came in the Top Champion’s stead?\nWell, I cannot be bothered by that.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_08
text: I don’t care what the reason is—if we can make\na masterpiece together once more, then fine![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_09
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well then, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], are you
ready
to
open
wide
a
door
to the world of art?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_10
text: Avant-garde! Very well, then. Let us head to\nmy studio.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: common_2020_kusa_010_kusa_11
text: Not avant-garde! I simply cannot contain my\nexcitement to face you in battle once more.\r\nCome back as soon as you are able![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
